id.description:
Unique identifier of the availability.

**Note**: The value should be provided in the `site`:`productId` format.

site.description: Site code, defined when the site is created. The value should match the `site` query/path parameter value.

stockLevel.description: Stock level of the product, expressed as a number.

available.description: Flag indicating whether the product is available.

productId.description: Unique identifier of the product, generated when the product is created through the Product Service.

vendorId.description: Id of a vendor to which the availability belongs.

popularity.description: Popularity of the product, expressed as a number.

createdAt.description: Date and time when the availability was created.

modifiedAt.description: Date and time when the availability was last updated.
